introSections.title: What are
paragraphs: TMNT Fortnite maps are community-made islands inspired by Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles themes — city exploration, survival runs, combat arenas, and fast-paced mini-games. These islands are built with UEFN and designed for replayability with friends.

If you're looking for high-speed action, survival maps like Mega Ramp modes are great for quick sessions. If you want more freedom, city experience maps are ideal for exploring, fighting, and hanging out with a party.

tipSections.title: Tips for
items: Play with friends — survival runs and city maps are more fun with a party.
Mega Ramp tip: stay centered and make small corrections early instead of big turns late.
Favorite the map after playing so it's easier to return after updates.
If you want PvP, head into combat zones or gun game modes when available.

tipSections.title: How to
items: Open Fortnite → Search / Discover.
Enter the map code exactly (####-####-####).
Join the island and follow the in-game objectives.
Favorite the map to find it faster next time.

faqs.q: How do I enter a Fortnite map code?
faqs.a: Open Fortnite, go to Search/Discover, enter the island code (####-####-####), then select the result to play.

faqs.q: Are these TMNT Fortnite maps official?
faqs.a: These are community-created Fortnite experiences built with UEFN. This page is not affiliated with Nickelodeon or the TMNT brand.

faqs.q: What is TMNT Mega Ramp Survival?
faqs.a: A fast-paced survival experience focused on dodging hazards and staying alive as chaos increases on a mega ramp.

faqs.q: Is TMNT City a gun game map?
faqs.a: TMNT City is primarily a TMNT-themed city experience. Depending on the island's current version, it may include combat areas or game modes.

notes.tmnt-mega-ramp-survival: High-speed Mega Ramp survival with TMNT theme. Dodge chaos and survive the run.

introSections.title: What are
paragraphs: "Squid Game" Fortnite maps are community-made islands inspired by elimination-style minigames. You'll usually see fast rounds, high-stakes challenges, and chaotic competition — often designed for playing with friends.

Popular Squid-style modes include Red Light Green Light, survival rounds, objective minigames, 99 bots survival, boss battles, and party challenges. Map availability and XP can change over time depending on updates and island revisions.

tipSections.title: Tips for
items: Play with friends: most Squid-style rounds are more fun with a full party and faster re-queues.
If you want practice, pick bot-based variants to learn routes and mechanics before jumping into PvP rounds.
Rotate maps if XP slows down; calibration and diminishing returns can vary by island and update cycle.
Use voice chat or quick pings — coordination matters in elimination challenges and team rounds.

tipSections.title: How to
items: Open Fortnite → Search / Discover.
Enter a map code exactly (####-####-####).
Join the map and follow the minigame rules (varies by island).
Play with friends for the best Squid-style elimination rounds.

faqs.q: How do I enter a Fortnite map code?
faqs.a: Open Fortnite, go to Search/Discover, enter the island code (####-####-####), then select the result to play.

faqs.q: Are Squid Game Fortnite maps official?
faqs.a: No. These are community-created Fortnite experiences inspired by Squid Game-style minigames and challenges, not official Netflix content.

faqs.q: Do Squid Game maps give XP?
faqs.a: Some islands may grant XP depending on Fortnite calibration and map settings. XP rates can change after updates or revisions.

faqs.q: What Squid Game maps are best to play with friends?
faqs.a: Minigame and elimination-style Squid maps are usually best with a full party. They're more fun when you can run rounds quickly and compete with friends.

introSections.title: What is a Fortnite
paragraphs: Fortnite Gun Game is a weapon progression PvP mode built for quick, replayable rounds. Players start with a weapon and upgrade after each elimination.
The goal is to finish the weapon list before everyone else. Great Gun Game maps have strong flow, balanced weapon rotations, and fast respawns.

tipSections.title: Tips to win
items: Learn spawn flow and rotate fights.
Hold angles and re-peek smart.
Mid-range accuracy beats flashy plays.
Keep moving to upgrade weapons faster.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: We use member information to run NLDEVS, support players, organize playtests, and find future collaborators. We keep it practical, limited, and never sell it.

sections.title: What We Collect
items: Name and email address when you join or check in as a member.
Optional player details such as Fortnite name, Discord username, favorite map, profile style, member goals, messages, and submitted images.
Optional developer or creator details such as role, availability, portfolio link, and skills.
A required confirmation that the member is 13 or older and has parent or guardian permission if under 18.
Basic technical details such as source page and browser information to help us understand where signups come from and troubleshoot issues.

sections.title: How We Use It
items: To recognize returning members.
To respond to messages, bug reports, map ideas, and collaboration interest.
To invite interested members to playtests, map updates, or NLDEVS opportunities.
To improve the website, maps, and member experience.

sections.title: How We Protect It
items: Member submissions are handled through a server route so secret database keys are not exposed in browser code.
Database access is restricted with Supabase Row Level Security and server-side credentials.
We do not sell member information.
We limit the information we ask for and keep optional fields optional.

privacy.emailsBody: If you join NLDEVS, we may send a short confirmation email. We only use your contact consent for future updates, playtests, or map news.
privacy.manageBody: To update or delete your member info, email <mail>nldevsmtl@gmail.com</mail>. Use the same email address you joined with so we can find the right record.
privacy.thirdPartyBody: NLDEVS uses trusted services such as Supabase for member data and Resend for email delivery. Those services process data only as needed to provide the site features.
